confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of UK city pricing for July 2026, with no live listings or booking pages checked. Values were reasoned in GBP and converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.33 USD per GBP. Restaurant, café and pub anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is most uncertain because Cambridge summer demand and room supply vary a lot. Hostel dorm and private-room prices are the least certain, since Cambridge has few registered hostels. The FX observation came from search-result summaries that attribute 0.6955 on 2026-10-15 to the RBA exchange-rates overview page. I did not open that page or the RBA F11.1 table directly, so the value should be checked against the official RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other English university and cathedral cities with similar visitor demand, such as Oxford, Bath and York, adjusted for Cambridge's typically high summer accommodation prices. Pub and café prices follow ordinary UK urban levels.
